scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev --workspace @babmatj/server" "npm run dev --workspace @babmatj/restaurant-web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace @babmatj/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @babmatj/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @babmatj/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @babmatj/restaurant-web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @babmatj/contracts && npm run build --workspace @babmatj/server && npm run test:api && npm run test:db
scripts.local:setup: npm run build --workspace @babmatj/contracts && npm run build --workspace @babmatj/server && npm run local:setup --workspace @babmatj/server
